page_title: NOT 2-2 LUT | Nottingham Forest v Luton 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Samuel Barrott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Murillo (Nottingham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+8' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Chris Wood (Nottingham) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+7' Andros Townsend (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+2' 2 - 2 Elijah Adebayo (Luton) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
90+1' 8:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Serge Aurier is replaced by Ola Aina (Nottingham).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Neco Williams (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Elanga cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' A lofted cross from Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
83' 2 - 1 Goal! Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top right corner. It's 2:1.
82' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) has tested the patience of referee Samuel Barrott and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replacing Carlton Morris.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joe Worrall (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch so that Willy Boly can be given a rest.
78' A substitution has been made. Ibrahim Sangare is replaced by Cheikhou Kouyate (Nottingham).
78' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez will be replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
76' 2 - 0 Chris Wood (Nottingham) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
74' Alfie Doughty (Luton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
72' The game has come to an end for Jacob Brown. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
72' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute Tahith Chong and he is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
72' The referee signals a substitution. Ross Barkley (Luton) is brought on as a substitute for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu.
71' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
68' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
66' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
64' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) is penalised for holding. Samuel Barrott signals a set piece.
62' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
60' Yellow card. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
57' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' Rob Edwards is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Reece Burke suffers an injury and Issa Kabore (Luton) comes on.
55' Reece Burke (Luton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
54' Looks like Reece Burke (Luton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
52' Matt Turner makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Jacob Brown (Luton) after a cross from the side.
50' Chris Wood (Nottingham) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
48' 1 - 0 Chris Wood (Nottingham) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Thomas Kaminski with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
46' The whistle blows and Samuel Barrott starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
44' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Orel Mangala (Nottingham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

40' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Samuel Barrott with no other option than to blow for a foul.
38' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
35' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Serge Aurier (Nottingham).
33' Carlton Morris (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
31' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' Serge Aurier (Nottingham) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
24' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
21' Luton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
19' Jacob Brown (Luton) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the left post.
17' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

15' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nottingham.
11' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
9' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
7' Chris Wood (Nottingham) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Thomas Kaminski makes a smart save to deny him.
4' Orel Mangala (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Samuel Barrott has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
2' Reece Burke (Luton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Luton will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Samuel Barrott.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
